entry.title: My Book List
entry.content:
I figured a while ago that since reducing my screen time is very hard, I might as well just do something productive on my phone. Thus, I read here and there on my phone. I also have a thing for libraries and buying books.

My Last Ten Books

  • 桶川跟踪狂杀人事件 - 清水洁
  • 万历十五年
  • 傲慢与偏见 (My guilty pleasure)
  • 活着 - 余华
  • Netochka Nezvanova - Fyodor Dostoevsky
  • 一句顶一万句 - 刘震云
  • Norwegian Wood - Haruki Murakami
  • Everything I Know About Love - Dolly Alderton
  • Breaking Through: My Life in Science - Katalin Karikó
  • 倾城之恋 - 张爱玲
  • My Brilliant Friend - Elena Ferrante
  • Crying in H Mart - Michelle Zauner
  • The World I See - Feifei Li
